content: Prompt-embedded nu one-liners must be shell-single-quoted: a nu -c "..." snippet inside an agent prompt loses every $-variable to bash double-quote interpolation (empty strings -> nu parse errors). Verified pattern (architect survey.md, run 01M2N36HV2C1T27FRHBS15Y3ZH): wrap the nu script in single quotes, use double-quoted nu strings inside, prefer fixed-position str substring over regex groups to avoid nested-quote escapes, and dry-run the exact fenced command extracted from the markdown before shipping the prompt.

description: dup-run-check.nu classify-filed subject regex drifted from the revisor commit-convention: it covered 'revise run' but not 'revise develop run', and 'file N seeds' / '; file fabro-x' but not the 'file seeds fabro-X and fabro-Y' list shape (real 706d639). Consequence: revisor filing commits landed among implementations with closure=foreign and forced verdict=duplicate (fabro-0d48). Convention: every new revisor subject shape must be pinned in .fabro/scripts/dup-run-check-fixtures.nu in the same change; the battery is the regression net.
resolution: fabro-0d48: extended the classifier regex with '\brevise\s+(develop\s+)?run\b' and '\bfile\s+seeds?\s+fabro-[0-9a-z]+' and pinned the 706d639 shape as fixtures case (i).

name: nu-loop-script-pitfalls
description: Writing .fabro nu scripts (revisor overflow-ledger, fabro-552a session): (1) nu 0.115 `ls '<glob>'` misses hidden-path components like `.fabro/...` — use the `glob` command instead; (2) never build trailing newlines with `str join X | append '' | str join X` — `append` on a joined scalar re-splits the string on the separator and doubles it (use `++ "\n"` string concat); (3) required flags need the block signature form `def "main sub" [--file: path ...] { }` — the positional `--flag: type` form only supports optional-with-default; (4) fixture seed ids must be non-hex (fabro-fixNN) or prompt-lint flags them unresolvable.
